learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to play word games! We will find word twins, word opposites, and words that try to trick our ears.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Synonyms are words that look different but mean the exact same thing! Happy and Glad are synonyms. Big and Huge are synonyms too.
Antonyms are words that mean the total opposite of each other. Hot and Cold are antonyms. Fast and Slow are antonyms!
Homophones are words that sound exactly the same when you say them, but have different spellings and meanings! Like the Sea (water) and See (with your eyes).

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Opposite Day Challenge!
fun_activity.instructions: For five minutes, play Opposite Day with your parents! If they say 'Stand up', you must 'Sit down'. If they say 'Hello', you say 'Goodbye'!

quick_recap: ⭐ Synonyms are words with the same meaning.
⭐ Antonyms are words with opposite meanings.
⭐ Homophones sound the same but are spelled differently and mean different things.
